sources.label: Skehan's — Live Music
sources.notes: Skehan's own weekly live-music programme (checked 2026-07-12): Monday Jam Sessions 20:30, Tuesday Trad Session 19:00, Wednesday South London Jam 20:00, The Big Saturday Night Gig 21:00, Sunday Night Folk Sessions 19:00. Friday alternates Karaoke/Rock'n'Roll — not included (ambiguous which runs on a given week).

sources.label: The Ivy House — What's On
sources.notes: The Ivy House's own 'Jazz + Roasts Sundays' — recurring Sunday 16:00 live jazz session, checked 2026-07-12.

sources.label: The Spice of Life — Events
sources.notes: The venue's own events page (checked 2026-07-12): 'Dove Jones Connection Blues & Jazz Jam Party … Every Monday Doors at 7pm' and 'Jazz Notes Jazz Jam … Every Sunday Doors at 1pm'.

sources.label: Ain't Nothin' But — What's On
sources.notes: The venue's own site (checked 2026-07-12): jams 'Sunday afternoons and Monday nights'; the Monday Blues Jam's own What's-On listing states 8pm-1am. Sunday jam has no published start time, so only Monday is emitted.

sources.label: Troubadour — Sunday Jazz
sources.notes: The venue's own Sunday Jazz page (checked 2026-07-12): weekly residency, doors 7:30pm, artists 8pm-10:30pm.

rows.title: Monday Night Blues Jam
rows.detail: The Soho blues bar's famous Monday night Blues Jam, 8pm-1am — bring your instrument and sign up on the night.

rows.title: Jazz + Roasts Sundays
rows.detail: Live jazz band on the community pub's stage, paired with Sunday roasts. Free entry; booking recommended for food.

rows.title: Monday Jam Sessions
rows.detail: An inclusive jam session open to all patrons — bring your own instrument and join in, or just come to listen.

rows.title: The Big Saturday Night Gig
rows.detail: Live music from Skehan's regular roster of musicians, into the night.

rows.title: Irish/English Trad Session
rows.detail: Traditional Irish and English music session, alternating performers every Tuesday.

rows.title: South London Jam
rows.detail: An eclectic mix of musicians getting together for a live jam.

rows.title: Dove Jones Connection Blues & Jazz Jam Party
rows.detail: Weekly blues and jazz jam residency on the Spice of Life stage. Doors 7pm, per the venue's own events page.

rows.title: Jazz Notes Jazz Jam
rows.detail: Weekly Sunday-afternoon jazz jam — instrumentalists and singers welcome to join on the day. Doors 1pm, per the venue's own events page.

rows.title: Jazz Sundays
rows.detail: Longstanding weekly jazz residency directed by Sebastiaan de Krom. Doors and table reservations 7:30pm; artists play 8pm-10:30pm. Booking recommended.
